```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
if (!requireNamespace("forecast", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Install package 'forecast'.")
```

# 1. Settings

```{r settings}
workers    <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("STORE_SALES_WORKERS", "4"))  # cores used for stage 2
h          <- 16L                                        # forecast horizon (days)
origins    <- as.Date(c("2017-07-14", "2017-07-30"))     # last training day of each window
start_full <- as.Date("2013-01-01")                      # default fitting start
start_late <- as.Date("2015-01-01")                      # alternative tested in A3
pools      <- c("series", "family", "global")
blocks_all <- c("holidays", "christmas", "mothers", "quake", "promo_gap")
drop_rule  <- 0.005                                      # A2: required improvement to drop a block
start_rule <- 0.02                                       # A3: required improvement to adopt 2015
cache_dir  <- "selection_cache"                          # one file per run; delete files after changing model code
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

Two test windows: fit to July 14 and forecast July 15 to 30; fit to July 30
and forecast July 31 to August 15. Each specification is scored by the RMSLE
pooled over both windows, and every run is saved, so an interrupted knit
resumes where it stopped.

# 2. Data import

Same loading step and object names as `storesales.rmd`.

```{r read-data}
data_dir <- Sys.getenv("STORE_SALES_DATA", "store-sales-time-series-forecasting")
if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) stop("Knit from the Kaggle folder containing the data directory.")
csv_files <- sort(list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE))
datasets <- setNames(lapply(csv_files, function(path) {
  x <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if ("date" %in% names(x)) x$date <- as.Date(x$date)
  x
}), tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(csv_files)))
required <- c("train", "test", "stores", "oil", "holidays_events",
              "transactions", "sample_submission")
stopifnot(all(required %in% names(datasets)))
train <- datasets$train; test <- datasets$test; stores <- datasets$stores
holidays_events <- datasets$holidays_events; oil <- datasets$oil
# Data correction: Good Friday 2013 was March 29 (the file has April 29, a Monday)
holidays_events$date[holidays_events$description == "Viernes Santo" &
  holidays_events$date == as.Date("2013-04-29")] <- as.Date("2013-03-29")
```

# 3. Covariates

All covariates are built on a store-by-date calendar from 2013-01-01 to
2017-08-31; promotions are added per row.

| Group | Covariates | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Fixed | trend, weekday dummies, log(1 + promotions) | always included |
| Tested (A1) | 1 to 3 annual Fourier pairs; smoothed oil; payday dummies (15th, month end) | best combination by pooled RMSLE |
| Block `holidays` | one dummy per national holiday (its transfers included); bridge days; make-up workdays; one regional/local holiday dummy | default; removing it reverts to the single holiday flag of `storesales.rmd` |
| Block `christmas` | holiday shopping season (Dec 16 to 24, 26, 30, 31, Jan 2 to 3); January 1 | default |
| Block `mothers` | Mother's Day | default |
| Block `quake` | first week after the 2016 earthquake (all stores); 8 weeks (Manabí stores) | default |
| Block `promo_gap` | before April 2014, when promotions were not recorded | default |

Smoothed oil is the mean of the last 30 available prices, carried forward to
weekends and missing days.

`make_holiday_calendar` is copied unchanged from `storesales.rmd`; it gives
the single holiday flag used when the `holidays` block is removed.

```{r storesales-holiday-function}
make_holiday_calendar <- function(stores, events, dates) {
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(stores$store_nbr))
  out <- expand.grid(date = dates, store_nbr = stores$store_nbr)
  out$date <- as.Date(out$date, origin = "1970-01-01")
  out$holiday <- 0L; out$workday <- 0L
  eligible <- !is.na(events$transferred) &
    tolower(as.character(events$transferred)) == "false"
  e <- events[eligible & events$type %in%
    c("Holiday", "Transfer", "Additional", "Bridge", "Work Day"), ]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(e))) {
    st <- switch(e$locale[i], National = stores$store_nbr,
      Regional = stores$store_nbr[stores$state == e$locale_name[i]],
      Local = stores$store_nbr[stores$city == e$locale_name[i]], integer())
    ix <- out$date == e$date[i] & out$store_nbr %in% st
    field <- if (e$type[i] == "Work Day") "workday" else "holiday"
    out[[field]][ix] <- 1L
  }
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(paste(out$date, out$store_nbr)))
  out
}
```

```{r calendar}
dates <- seq(start_full, max(test$date), by = "day")
cal <- expand.grid(date = dates, store_nbr = stores$store_nbr)
cal$date <- as.Date(cal$date, origin = "1970-01-01")
cal_state <- stores$state[match(cal$store_nbr, stores$store_nbr)]
time <- as.numeric(cal$date - start_full)

C <- data.frame(trend = time / 365.25)
weekday <- (as.integer(cal$date) + 3L) %% 7L + 1L            # 1 = Monday, as in storesales.rmd
for (k in 2:7) C[[paste0("wd", k)]] <- as.integer(weekday == k)
for (k in 1:3) {
  C[[paste0("sin", k)]] <- sin(2 * pi * k * time / 365.25)
  C[[paste0("cos", k)]] <- cos(2 * pi * k * time / 365.25)
}
C$payday15   <- as.integer(format(cal$date, "%d") == "15")
C$payday_end <- as.integer(format(cal$date + 1L, "%m") != format(cal$date, "%m"))

# Oil: trailing mean of the last 30 available prices
o  <- oil[!is.na(oil$dcoilwtico), ]; o <- o[order(o$date), ]
cs <- cumsum(o$dcoilwtico); n_obs <- seq_along(cs)
ma <- ifelse(n_obs > 30, (cs - c(rep(0, 30), head(cs, -30))) / 30, cs / n_obs)
C$oil <- ma[pmax(1L, findInterval(cal$date, o$date))]

# Single holiday flag and make-up workdays (storesales.rmd definition)
hc <- make_holiday_calendar(stores, holidays_events, dates)
m  <- match(paste(cal$date, cal$store_nbr), paste(hc$date, hc$store_nbr))
C$hol_coarse <- hc$holiday[m]
C$workday    <- hc$workday[m]

# Detailed holidays
ev <- holidays_events[!is.na(holidays_events$transferred) &
  tolower(as.character(holidays_events$transferred)) == "false", ]
flag <- function(rows) {
  out <- integer(nrow(cal))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    st <- switch(rows$locale[i], National = stores$store_nbr,
      Regional = stores$store_nbr[stores$state == rows$locale_name[i]],
      Local = stores$store_nbr[stores$city == rows$locale_name[i]], integer())
    out[cal$date == rows$date[i] & cal$store_nbr %in% st] <- 1L
  }
  out
}
nat_names <- c(carnaval = "Carnaval", viernes_santo = "Viernes Santo",
  trabajo = "Dia del Trabajo", pichincha = "Batalla de Pichincha",
  primer_grito = "Primer Grito de Independencia", guayaquil = "Independencia de Guayaquil",
  difuntos = "Dia de Difuntos", cuenca = "Independencia de Cuenca")
nat <- ev[ev$locale == "National" & ev$type %in% c("Holiday", "Transfer"), ]
nat$name <- sub("^Traslado ", "", nat$description)
for (k in names(nat_names)) C[[paste0("nat_", k)]] <- flag(nat[nat$name == nat_names[k], ])
C$bridge    <- flag(ev[ev$type == "Bridge", ])
C$local_hol <- flag(ev[ev$locale %in% c("Regional", "Local") &
  ev$type %in% c("Holiday", "Transfer", "Additional", "Bridge"), ])

# Christmas and New Year
md <- format(cal$date, "%m-%d")
C$season <- as.integer(md %in% c(sprintf("12-%02d", 16:24), "12-26", "12-30", "12-31", "01-02", "01-03"))
C$jan1   <- as.integer(md == "01-01")

# Mother's Day, earthquake, unrecorded promotions
C$mothers      <- flag(ev[ev$type == "Event" & ev$description == "Dia de la Madre", ])
C$quake_nat    <- as.integer(cal$date >= as.Date("2016-04-16") & cal$date <= as.Date("2016-04-22"))
C$quake_manabi <- as.integer(cal$date >= as.Date("2016-04-16") & cal$date <= as.Date("2016-06-10") &
  cal_state == "Manabi")
C$promo_gap    <- as.integer(cal$date < as.Date("2014-04-01"))

C <- as.matrix(C)
cal_key <- paste(cal$date, cal$store_nbr)
```

A specification is the Fourier count `K`, whether oil and paydays are in,
and which default blocks are in:

```{r spec}
spec_cols <- function(spec) {
  b <- spec$blocks
  c("trend", paste0("wd", 2:7), "promo",
    as.vector(rbind(paste0("sin", seq_len(spec$K)), paste0("cos", seq_len(spec$K)))),
    if (spec$oil) "oil",
    if (spec$payday) c("payday15", "payday_end"),
    if ("holidays" %in% b) c(paste0("nat_", names(nat_names)), "bridge", "workday", "local_hol")
      else c("hol_coarse", "workday"),
    if ("christmas" %in% b) c("season", "jan1"),
    if ("mothers" %in% b) "mothers",
    if ("quake" %in% b) c("quake_nat", "quake_manabi"),
    if ("promo_gap" %in% b) "promo_gap")
}
spec_label <- function(spec) paste0("K=", spec$K, if (spec$oil) ", oil", if (spec$payday) ", paydays",
  "; blocks: ", if (length(spec$blocks)) paste(spec$blocks, collapse = ", ") else "none")
spec_id <- function(spec, pool, origin, start) paste(pool, format(start, "%Y"), format(origin),
  paste0("K", spec$K), if (spec$oil) "oil" else "nooil", if (spec$payday) "pay" else "nopay",
  if (length(spec$blocks)) paste(sort(spec$blocks), collapse = "-") else "none", sep = "_")
```

# 4. Modelling data

The panel holds the training rows from 2013 and the Kaggle test rows (sales
unknown), so the same code later produces the submission. In each run, a
series' rows before its first sale up to the training cut-off are excluded
from fitting.

```{r panel}
panel <- rbind(train[train$date >= start_full, c("id", "date", "store_nbr", "family", "sales", "onpromotion")],
  data.frame(test[, c("id", "date", "store_nbr", "family")], sales = NA_real_, onpromotion = test$onpromotion))
panel$key <- paste(panel$store_nbr, panel$family, sep = " | ")
panel$z   <- log1p(panel$sales)
panel$ci  <- match(paste(panel$date, panel$store_nbr), cal_key)
stopifnot(!anyNA(panel$ci))
family_rows <- split(seq_len(nrow(panel)), panel$family)

build_X <- function(rows, cols) {
  X <- C[panel$ci[rows], setdiff(cols, "promo"), drop = FALSE]
  if ("promo" %in% cols) X <- cbind(X, promo = log1p(panel$onpromotion[rows]))
  X
}
```

# 5. Model

Same two-stage model as `holdout.Rmd`. For series $s$ on day $t$, with
$z = \log(1 + \text{sales})$:

$$z_{s,t} = a_s + b_{g(s)}^\top x_{s,t} + n_{s,t}$$

Stage 1 estimates $a_s$ and $b_g$ by least squares on series-demeaned data,
with $b$ per series, per family or global. Stage 2 fits `auto.arima` (weekly
period) to each series' residuals, with the missing December 25 values
interpolated. Fallback rules follow `storesales.rmd`: zero for series with
no sales or no sales in the last 91 days (at least a year of mostly zeros, no
promotions ahead); last value per weekday for fewer than 60 days of history
or a failed fit.

```{r stage1}
fit_b <- function(X, z) { b <- lm.fit(X, z)$coefficients; b[is.na(b)] <- 0; b }

stage1 <- function(cols, pool, origin, start) {
  pos <- panel$date <= origin & !is.na(panel$sales) & panel$sales > 0
  first_sale <- tapply(as.numeric(panel$date[pos]), panel$key[pos], min)
  fs <- first_sale[panel$key]                                  # NA if no sale by the cut-off
  train_mask <- panel$date >= start & panel$date <= origin & !is.na(fs) & as.numeric(panel$date) >= fs
  test_mask  <- panel$date > origin & panel$date <= origin + h
  prep <- function(f) {
    rows <- family_rows[[f]]
    i <- rows[train_mask[rows]]; j <- rows[test_mask[rows]]
    if (!length(i)) return(NULL)
    Xi <- build_X(i, cols); g <- panel$key[i]
    n  <- rowsum(rep(1, length(i)), g)[, 1]
    mx <- rowsum(Xi, g) / n; mz <- rowsum(panel$z[i], g)[, 1] / n
    ig <- match(g, names(n))
    list(i = i, j = j, g = g, gj = panel$key[j], mx = mx, mz = mz,
         Xd = Xi - mx[ig, , drop = FALSE], zd = panel$z[i] - mz[ig], Xj = build_X(j, cols))
  }
  if (pool == "global") {                                      # one regression over all families
    XtX <- 0; Xtz <- 0
    for (f in names(family_rows)) {
      blk <- prep(f); if (is.null(blk)) next
      XtX <- XtX + crossprod(blk$Xd); Xtz <- Xtz + crossprod(blk$Xd, blk$zd)
    }
    b_all <- as.vector(qr.coef(qr(XtX), Xtz)); b_all[is.na(b_all)] <- 0
  }
  e <- r <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(panel))
  for (f in names(family_rows)) {
    blk <- prep(f); if (is.null(blk)) next
    if (pool == "family") b_fam <- fit_b(blk$Xd, blk$zd)
    si <- split(seq_along(blk$g), blk$g); sj <- split(seq_along(blk$gj), blk$gj)
    for (k in names(si)) {
      ii <- si[[k]]
      b <- switch(pool, series = fit_b(blk$Xd[ii, , drop = FALSE], blk$zd[ii]), family = b_fam, global = b_all)
      e[blk$i[ii]] <- blk$zd[ii] - as.vector(blk$Xd[ii, , drop = FALSE] %*% b)
      jj <- sj[[k]]
      if (length(jj)) r[blk$j[jj]] <- blk$mz[[k]] +
        as.vector(sweep(blk$Xj[jj, , drop = FALSE], 2, blk$mx[k, ]) %*% b)
    }
  }
  list(e = e, r = r, train_mask = train_mask, test_mask = test_mask)
}
```

```{r stage2}
complete_residuals <- function(e, d) {
  full <- seq(min(d), max(d), by = "day")                      # every calendar day, including absent ones
  forecast::na.interp(ts(e[match(full, d)], frequency = 7))
}

weekday_naive <- function(y, d, d_new) {
  out <- rep(tail(y, 1), length(d_new))
  for (j in seq_along(d_new)) {
    v <- y[as.integer(d) %% 7L == as.integer(d_new[j]) %% 7L]
    if (length(v)) out[j] <- tail(v, 1)
  }
  out
}

stage2_job <- function(j) {
  y <- j$y; n_te <- length(j$d_te)
  if (!length(y) || all(y == 0)) return(rep(0, n_te))
  inactive <- length(y) >= 365 && mean(y == 0) >= 0.9 && all(tail(y, 91) == 0) && all(j$promo_te == 0)
  if (inactive) return(rep(0, n_te))
  if (length(y) < 60) return(weekday_naive(y, j$d_tr, j$d_te))
  tryCatch({
    e   <- complete_residuals(j$e, j$d_tr)
    fit <- forecast::auto.arima(e, max.p = 2, max.q = 2, max.P = 1, max.Q = 1,
      max.d = 1, max.D = 1, allowdrift = FALSE)
    ef  <- as.numeric(forecast::forecast(fit, h = h)$mean)
    pmax(0, expm1(j$r + ef[as.integer(j$d_te - j$origin)]))
  }, error = function(err) weekday_naive(y, j$d_tr, j$d_te))
}

cl <- parallel::makePSOCKcluster(min(workers, parallel::detectCores()))
parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("h", "complete_residuals", "weekday_naive", "stage2_job"))
```

# 6. Running and scoring

```{r run}
run_one <- function(spec, pool, origin, start) {
  file <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0(spec_id(spec, pool, origin, start), ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(file)) return(readRDS(file))
  t0 <- proc.time()[3]
  s1 <- stage1(spec_cols(spec), pool, origin, start)
  tr <- split(which(s1$train_mask), panel$key[s1$train_mask])
  te <- split(which(s1$test_mask), panel$key[s1$test_mask])
  jobs <- lapply(names(te), function(k) {
    i <- tr[[k]]; j <- te[[k]]
    list(y = panel$sales[i], d_tr = panel$date[i], e = s1$e[i], d_te = panel$date[j],
         promo_te = panel$onpromotion[j], r = s1$r[j], origin = origin, rows = j)
  })
  pred <- unlist(parallel::parLapply(cl, jobs, stage2_job))
  rows <- unlist(lapply(jobs, `[[`, "rows"))
  out <- data.frame(id = panel$id[rows], key = panel$key[rows], family = panel$family[rows],
                    date = panel$date[rows], actual = panel$sales[rows], pred = pred)
  saveRDS(out, file)
  cat(spec_id(spec, pool, origin, start), ":", round((proc.time()[3] - t0) / 60, 1), "min\n", file = stderr())
  out
}

rmsle <- function(d) sqrt(mean((log1p(d$pred) - log1p(d$actual))^2))

score <- function(spec, pool, start) {
  res <- lapply(origins, function(o) run_one(spec, pool, o, start))
  c(pooled = rmsle(do.call(rbind, res)), w1 = rmsle(res[[1]]), w2 = rmsle(res[[2]]))
}
```

Every series is scored, including those that never sold (forecast as zero).

# 7. A1: Fourier pairs, oil and paydays

All 12 combinations, with every default block included, for each structure.
The lowest pooled RMSLE is kept.

```{r a1, results='asis'}
grid <- expand.grid(K = 1:3, oil = c(TRUE, FALSE), payday = c(TRUE, FALSE))
best_spec <- list(); a1 <- list()
for (p in pools) {
  sc <- t(sapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i)
    score(list(K = grid$K[i], oil = grid$oil[i], payday = grid$payday[i], blocks = blocks_all), p, start_full)))
  a1[[p]] <- cbind(grid, sc)
  b <- which.min(a1[[p]]$pooled)
  best_spec[[p]] <- list(K = grid$K[b], oil = grid$oil[b], payday = grid$payday[b], blocks = blocks_all)
}
for (p in pools) {
  print(knitr::kable(a1[[p]][order(a1[[p]]$pooled), ], digits = 4, row.names = FALSE,
    caption = paste("A1:", p, "(w1 = window to July 30, w2 = window to August 15)")))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# 8. A2: default blocks

Backward elimination: each remaining block is removed in turn; the removal
with the largest improvement is made if it lowers the pooled RMSLE by more
than 0.5% and lowers it in both windows. Repeat until no removal qualifies.

```{r a2, results='asis'}
a2 <- list()
for (p in pools) {
  cur <- best_spec[[p]]; cur_sc <- score(cur, p, start_full); steps <- list()
  while (length(cur$blocks)) {
    sc <- t(sapply(cur$blocks, function(b) {
      s <- cur; s$blocks <- setdiff(cur$blocks, b); score(s, p, start_full) }))
    tab <- data.frame(removed = cur$blocks, sc, row.names = NULL)
    tab$improvement <- 1 - tab$pooled / cur_sc[["pooled"]]
    tab$both_windows <- tab$w1 < cur_sc[["w1"]] & tab$w2 < cur_sc[["w2"]]
    tab$drop <- tab$improvement > drop_rule & tab$both_windows
    steps[[length(steps) + 1L]] <- tab
    if (!any(tab$drop)) break
    k <- which(tab$drop)[which.max(tab$improvement[tab$drop])]
    cur$blocks <- setdiff(cur$blocks, tab$removed[k])
    cur_sc <- unlist(tab[k, c("pooled", "w1", "w2")])
  }
  a2[[p]] <- steps; best_spec[[p]] <- cur
}
for (p in pools) for (s in seq_along(a2[[p]])) {
  print(knitr::kable(a2[[p]][[s]], digits = 4,
    caption = paste0("A2: ", p, ", step ", s, " (improvement relative to the current model)")))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# 9. A3: start date

The selected specification is refitted from 2015. 2015 is adopted only if it
lowers the pooled RMSLE by more than 2% and lowers it in both windows.

```{r a3}
a3 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pools, function(p) {
  s13 <- score(best_spec[[p]], p, start_full); s15 <- score(best_spec[[p]], p, start_late)
  imp <- 1 - s15[["pooled"]] / s13[["pooled"]]
  both <- s15[["w1"]] < s13[["w1"]] & s15[["w2"]] < s13[["w2"]]
  data.frame(structure = p, pooled_2013 = s13[["pooled"]], pooled_2015 = s15[["pooled"]],
             improvement = imp, both_windows = both, start = if (imp > start_rule && both) 2015L else 2013L)
}))
knitr::kable(a3, digits = 4, caption = "A3: start date")
```

# 10. Selected models

```{r final}
final <- lapply(pools, function(p) {
  start <- if (a3$start[a3$structure == p] == 2015L) start_late else start_full
  res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(origins, function(o) cbind(window = format(o), run_one(best_spec[[p]], p, o, start))))
  list(structure = p, spec = best_spec[[p]], start = start, results = res)
})
names(final) <- pools
knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(final, function(f) data.frame(structure = f$structure,
  specification = spec_label(f$spec), start = format(f$start, "%Y"),
  pooled = rmsle(f$results), w1 = rmsle(f$results[f$results$window == format(origins[1]), ]),
  w2 = rmsle(f$results[f$results$window == format(origins[2]), ])))),
  digits = 4, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Selected specification per structure")

by_family <- sapply(final, function(f) {
  sq <- (log1p(f$results$pred) - log1p(f$results$actual))^2
  sqrt(tapply(sq, f$results$family, mean))
})
knitr::kable(by_family[order(-by_family[, "family"]), ], digits = 3,
  caption = "Pooled RMSLE by product family, selected models")

saveRDS(final, "selection_final.rds")
```

# 11. Kaggle submissions

Each selected model is refitted on all training data (to August 15, from its
selected start date) and forecasts the Kaggle test period, August 16 to 31.
The per-family submission takes each product family's forecasts from the
structure with the lowest holdout RMSLE for that family (table above).

```{r submissions}
final_origin <- max(train$date)
write_submission <- function(res, file) {
  res <- res[match(test$id, res$id), ]
  stopifnot(identical(res$id, test$id), all(is.finite(res$pred)), all(res$pred >= 0))
  write.csv(data.frame(id = res$id, sales = res$pred), file, row.names = FALSE)
  res
}
subs <- list()
for (p in pools) subs[[p]] <- write_submission(
  run_one(final[[p]]$spec, p, final_origin, final[[p]]$start), paste0("submission_", p, ".csv"))

family_choice <- setNames(colnames(by_family)[apply(by_family, 1, which.min)], rownames(by_family))
per_family <- subs[[1]]
for (p in pools) {
  use <- family_choice[per_family$family] == p
  per_family$pred[use] <- subs[[p]]$pred[use]
}
invisible(write_submission(per_family, "submission_per_family.csv"))

knitr::kable(data.frame(family = names(family_choice), structure = unname(family_choice)),
  row.names = FALSE, caption = "Structure used for each family in submission_per_family.csv")
parallel::stopCluster(cl)
```

Files written: `submission_series.csv`, `submission_family.csv`,
`submission_global.csv` and `submission_per_family.csv`.
